arguments.message: Hi there! A genuine Meridian invoice will always appear in your account under **Settings → Billing → Invoices**. If the invoice you received by email doesn’t match anything you see there (different amount, due date, or plan details), it’s a strong sign it’s not a real Meridian invoice. Treat it as unverified and don’t pay it until you can confirm it in the Billing section or with us directly.
